name: Lisbon
description: Hilly coastal capital with tiled streets, custard tarts, fado music and easy day trips to Sintra and the beach.

name: Porto
description: Riverside city known for port wine cellars, azulejo-covered churches and a compact walkable center.

name: Barcelona
description: Gaudi architecture, tapas bars and city beaches. Watch for pickpockets in crowded areas.

name: Madrid
description: World-class art museums, late dinners and lively plazas.

name: Paris
description: Museums, cafes, bakeries and iconic landmarks, best explored on foot.

name: Rome
description: Ancient ruins, Renaissance churches and classic pasta, with history on nearly every block.

name: Florence
description: Renaissance art capital with a compact center and Tuscan wine country nearby.

name: Amalfi Coast
description: Cliffside villages, lemon groves and Mediterranean views. Steep stairs and winding roads.

name: London
description: Free major museums, markets, theater and pubs across a huge variety of neighborhoods.

name: Edinburgh
description: Medieval old town, a castle on a volcanic rock and easy access to Highland day trips.

name: Dublin
description: Pubs with live music, literary history and quick trips to coastal cliffs.

name: Amsterdam
description: Canals, bike-friendly streets and major museums.

name: Copenhagen
description: Design-forward city with great food, harbor swimming in summer and bikes everywhere.

name: Berlin
description: Cold War history, street art, museums and famously late nightlife.

name: Prague
description: Fairy-tale old town, castle views and inexpensive beer and food.

name: Vienna
description: Imperial palaces, classical music, coffee houses and Christmas markets.

name: Budapest
description: Thermal baths, ruin bars and grand riverside architecture at a low price.

name: Athens
description: The Acropolis, lively food scene and ancient sites close to modern neighborhoods.

name: Santorini
description: Clifftop villages with sunset views over a volcanic caldera. Very crowded in peak summer.

name: Dubrovnik
description: Walled medieval city on the Adriatic with island day trips.

name: Croatia
description: Adriatic islands, national parks with waterfalls and walled coastal towns.

name: Istanbul
description: Mosques, bazaars and ferry rides across two continents.

name: Reykjavik
description: Small capital and base for geothermal pools, waterfalls and northern lights trips.

name: Iceland
description: Glaciers, volcanoes and hot springs, best explored by driving the Ring Road.

name: Swiss Alps (Interlaken)
description: Lake towns beneath huge peaks with trains, hiking and skiing.

name: Marrakech
description: Souks, riads and spice-filled food stalls, with desert and mountain trips nearby.

name: Cairo
description: The pyramids of Giza and a massive museum scene in a busy, intense city.

name: Cape Town
description: Table Mountain, penguins, vineyards and coastal drives. Use standard city safety precautions.

name: Serengeti
description: Safari plains famous for the wildebeest migration.

name: Petra
description: Rock-carved ancient city reached on foot, with desert landscapes at Wadi Rum nearby.

name: Dubai
description: Skyscrapers, malls, desert tours and beaches. Very hot in summer.

name: Tokyo
description: Giant, safe, efficient city with extraordinary food at every price point.

name: Kyoto
description: Temples, gardens, tea houses and traditional cuisine. Very busy during cherry blossom and fall foliage.

name: Osaka
description: Japan's street food capital with a friendly, lively atmosphere.

name: Seoul
description: Palaces, markets, Korean barbecue and late-night energy.

name: Taipei
description: Night markets, hot springs and mountain trails within the metro area.

name: Hong Kong
description: Skyline views, dim sum and surprisingly good hiking right outside the city.

name: Bangkok
description: Street food, temples and rooftop bars in a hot, chaotic and affordable city.

name: Chiang Mai
description: Mountain-side old city with temples, cooking classes and ethical elephant sanctuaries.

name: Hanoi
description: Old Quarter street food, egg coffee and day trips to Ha Long Bay.

name: Ho Chi Minh City
description: Fast-moving southern city with war history, markets and Mekong Delta tours.

name: Singapore
description: Clean, safe city-state with hawker food, gardens and strict public rules.

name: Bali
description: Rice terraces, surf beaches, temples and wellness retreats.

name: Maldives
description: Overwater bungalows, lagoons and some of the best snorkeling and diving.

name: Kathmandu
description: Gateway to Himalayan treks, with ancient temples and crowded old squares.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City, with forts, palaces and bazaars full of textiles and jewelry.

name: Sydney
description: Harbor, opera house, surf beaches and coastal walks.

name: New Zealand
description: Fjords, volcanoes, glaciers and adventure sports across two islands.

name: Maui
description: Beaches, whale watching in winter, volcano sunrises and the Road to Hana.

name: New York City
description: Broadway, museums, parks and every cuisine imaginable. Subway access and lots of walking.

name: New Orleans
description: Live jazz, Creole and Cajun cooking, festivals and historic neighborhoods.

name: San Francisco
description: Bridges, hills, great restaurants and quick trips to wine country and redwoods.

name: Austin
description: Live music, barbecue, Hill Country day trips and swimming holes.

name: Yellowstone National Park
description: Geysers, hot springs and wildlife viewing. Needs a car and advance lodging booking.

name: Grand Canyon
description: Rim viewpoints and multi-day hikes. Summer heat at the bottom is dangerous.

name: Vancouver
description: Mountains and ocean next to a diverse, walkable city.

name: Banff National Park
description: Turquoise lakes and Rocky Mountain peaks, with hiking in summer and skiing in winter.

name: Montreal
description: French-speaking city with festivals, bagels, cafes and a strong arts scene.

name: Mexico City
description: Museums, street tacos and Aztec history. High altitude, and it takes a day to adjust.

name: Oaxaca
description: Mole, mezcal and Indigenous crafts, with Day of the Dead celebrations in fall.

name: Costa Rica
description: Rainforests, volcanoes, surf beaches and ziplining.

name: Cartagena
description: Colorful walled colonial city on the Caribbean coast with island day trips.

name: Cusco & Machu Picchu
description: Former Inca capital and gateway to Machu Picchu. High altitude, and permits are needed for the Inca Trail.

name: Buenos Aires
description: Steak, tango, bookstores and late-night dinners.

name: Patagonia
description: Jagged peaks, glaciers and multi-day treks such as Torres del Paine. Weather changes fast.

name: Rio de Janeiro
description: Beaches below dramatic peaks, samba and hikes with big views. Be careful with valuables and nighttime areas.

name: Galapagos Islands
description: Unique wildlife you can see up close on boat-based or island-hopping trips.
